title: Hero Skill Kit Browser UI Extension
purpose: Create a mobile-first read-only UI to browse inert hero skill kit catalogs exposed by RM1.26-C, without connecting catalogs to battle runtime, HP bar runtime, UI combat runtime, or balance runtime.

ui_sections.label: Summary
requirements: Display 5★ count, 6★ launch_base count, 6★ extra premium count, total entries.
Display runtime flags: runtime_attached=false, battle_runtime_attached=false, hp_bar_runtime_attached=false, ui_runtime_attached=false, balance_values_finalized=false, do_not_treat_as_live_kit=true.
Display a persistent read-only warning banner.
Display all 20 5★ catalog entries.
Support local search by hero_id, display_name/name, role, element, faction if present.
Show slot chips for basic, passive_base, skill_1, passive_advanced, skill_2.
Clearly mark passive_advanced entries that are missing_from_approved_source / TODO_SOURCE_REQUIRED.
Clearly mark skill_2 entries converted from legacy ultimate as is_true_ultimate=false.
Display all 13 6★ catalog entries.
Separate launch_base (12) and launch_extra_premium (Borea) visually.
Show divine_weapon_id for each 6★.
Show slot chips basic, passive_base, skill_1, passive_advanced, skill_2, ultimate.
Borea must be shown as catalog design only; add explicit note that roster/gacha/battle availability is NOT affected.

ui_sections.label: Cerca Eroe
requirements: Provide a local text input for hero_id lookup.
May call GET /api/hero-skill-kits/catalogs/by-hero/{hero_id} only when user submits or after debounce; no network spam.
Test smoke for greek_atalanta, greek_athena, greek_borea, unknown_hero_xyz.
Show 404/empty state without errors or mutations.

ui_sections.label: Schema
requirements: Display schema metadata and slot progression summary.
Display explanation that final_numbers are null and balance is not finalized.
Display no-live-runtime flags.

read_only_rules: Only GET requests to hero skill kit catalog endpoints
No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE from the new screen
No direct JSON imports in frontend; consume API only
absolute_rules: No status icon HP bar activation
Do not modify inert hero skill kit JSON catalogs
Do not modify runtime kit JSON files
Do not connect catalogs to battle runtime
Do not connect catalogs to HP bar runtime
acceptance_criteria: New screen renders on mobile without React error overlay
Menu entry navigates to new screen
Summary shows counts 20/12/1/33 and runtime flags false
5★ section clearly marks 20 passive_advanced missing/TODO entries if present from catalog
5★ section clearly marks legacy ultimate converted to skill_2 with is_true_ultimate=false if present
6★ section shows Borea as extra premium catalog-only
By-hero smoke works for greek_atalanta, greek_athena, greek_borea and unknown 404
Search/filter is local or debounced and produces no network spam
No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE from new screen to catalog endpoints
No changes to battle_engine.py, combat.tsx, HP bar, gacha, roster, Character Bible, source design JSON
TS: zero new errors in modified files
